fact: At a Zambia Police Service training workshop in Lusaka on 29 November 2021, UNDP's representative listed among milestones reached with GIZ, ZPS and the EU Delegation the rollout of the Electronic Occurrence Book for improved case management, through donation of ICT equipment to the Victim Support Unit and training of police officers; no count of stations is given.
title: EU Committed to Fighting SGBV in the SADC Region
